headlines.description: Rob Bironas kicked his fourth field goal, a 40-yarder as time expired, and the Tennessee Titans beat the Pittsburgh Steelers 26-23 on Thursday night to snap a two-game skid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans rally, top Steelers on FG as time expires

headlines.description: Matt Bryant kicked his second game-winning field goal in three weeks, a 55-yarder with 1 second remaining, and the Atlanta Falcons remained unbeaten with a sloppy 23-20 victory over the Oakland Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons improve to 6-0 on Bryant's 55-yard FG

headlines.description: Rookie Brandon Weeden threw two touchdown passes and the Cleveland Browns snapped an 11-game losing streak that dated to last season, beating the Cincinnati Bengals 34-24 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns snap 11-game skid, beat rival Bengals

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Ryan Tannehill threw two touchdown passes, and the Miami Dolphins withstood a late rally by the St. Louis Rams to win 17-14 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tannehill throws 2 TDs, Dolphins hold off Rams

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at New York Jets

headlines.description: Shonn Greene ran for a career-high 161 yards and three touchdowns to power a rejuvenated "Ground-and-Pound" offense that rushed for more than 250 yards, Mark Sanchez was efficient and Tim Tebow made a few big plays in a 35-9 victory over the Colts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Greene, Sanchez lead Jets in blowout of Colts

headlines.description: Jason Hanson kicked a 45-yard field goal in overtime, and the Detroit Lions rallied from a 10-point fourth-quarter deficit to beat the Philadelphia Eagles 26-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions rally in 4th, then stun Eagles in OT

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Josh Freeman threw for 328 yards and three touchdowns and Ronde Barber scored on a 78-yard interception return to help the Tampa Bay Buccaneers beat the struggling Kansas City Chiefs 38-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freeman leads Bucs past short-handed Chiefs

headlines.description: Jacoby Jones tied an NFL record with a 108-yard kickoff return, and the Baltimore Ravens held on to beat the Dallas Cowboys 31-29 on Sunday for their 14th straight regular-season home win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens withstand late rally from Cowboys

headlines.description: Jairus Byrd's second interception of the game set up Rian Lindell's 25-yard field goal 3:50 into overtime that gave the Buffalo Bills a 19-16 victory over the Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills snap Cards' 8-game home run with FG in OT

events.name: New England Patriots at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Russell Wilson found Sidney Rice behind the secondary for a 46-yard touchdown with 1:18 remaining, and the Seattle Seahawks rallied for 14 points in the final 7:31 to stun the New England Patriots 24-23 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks score final 14 points, shock Patriots

events.name: New York Giants at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Antrel Rolle intercepted two passes by Alex Smith, Prince Amukamara picked off another and the Giants shut down San Francisco in a 26-3 victory over the 49ers on Sunday in a rematch of last season's NFC championship game.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants harass Smith into 3 INTs, roll over 49ers

headlines.description: Robert Griffin III ran for 138 yards and two touchdowns, including a 76-yard scamper with 2:43 to play, and the Washington Redskins snapped an eight-game home losing streak Sunday with a 38-26 win over the Minnesota Vikings.
headlines.shortLinkText: Griffin helps Redskins end 8-game skid at home

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Houston Texans

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers set a career high and tied a franchise record with six touchdown passes, three to Jordy Nelson, and the Green Bay Packers routed the previously unbeaten Houston Texans 42-24 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers stars as Packers hand Texans first loss

events.name: Denver Broncos at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw three touchdown passes in the second half and Tony Carter and Chris Harris scored off turnovers by Philip Rivers as the Denver Broncos overcame a 24-0 halftime deficit to stun the San Diego Chargers 35-24 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos rally from 24 down to shock Chargers
